title: Vibrio natriegens Electrocompetent Preparation
author: David Shis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z3ff8jn
materials: BHI media stock Brain Heart Infusion broth (BHI) Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1.10493.0500

BHI + v2 salts Brain Heart Infusion broth (BHI) Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1.10493.0500 - 204 millimolar (mM) NaCl - 4.2 millimolar (mM) KCl - 23.14 millimolar (mM) MgCl2 - 680 millimolar (mM) Sucrose Filter sterilize or autoclave

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 10 mL of [BHI + v2 salts] with V. natriegens and incubate overnight at 30 °C with agitation at 200 r.p.m.

steps.title: Inoculate and grow cells
steps.instruction: Prepare 60 mL of [BHI + v2 salts] in a baffled flask. Inoculate the media with the overnight culture at a dilution of 1:100 to 1:200. Incubate with shaking at 37 °C and 200 r.p.m. until an OD600 of 0.5 is reached.

steps.title: Initial cell chilling and pelleting
steps.instruction: Split the outgrowth into two chilled 50-mL falcon tubes and incubate on ice for 15 min. Pellet the cells at 4 °C, spinning at 5000 rcf for 10 min.

steps.title: First wash step
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant and gently resuspend the cell pellet in at least 1 mL of electroporation buffer (680 mM sucrose, 7 mM K2HPO4, pH 7).

steps.title: Perform repeated washes
steps.instruction: Wash the cells by repeating the pelleting and resuspension process at least three times (minimum of three washes).

substeps.instruction: Top off the centrifuge tube (typically a 50 mL falcon tube) with electroporation buffer and gently mix.
Pellet cells at 4 °C, spinning at 5000 rcf for 10 min.
Carefully aspirate away supernatant with a pipette until the volume is approximately 1-4 mL (the pellet does not need to be super dry).

steps.title: Final pellet concentration
steps.instruction: After the final wash and pelleting, carefully pipette off as much of the supernatant as possible. Resuspend the pellet so the final volume of cells plus electroporation buffer is approximately 50-100 uL.

steps.title: Aliquot and store cells
steps.instruction: Snap freeze cell aliquots (50 uL per electrocompetent aliquot) in a dry ice bath or liquid nitrogen. Store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Verify cell concentration
steps.instruction: Check concentration by performing a 1:1000 inoculation into BHI media; the OD should be 0.15 +/- 0.02. If too dilute, spin down and resuspend in a smaller volume.

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Transfer an aqueous electrocompetent aliquot to a chilled 0.1 cm gapped cuvette on ice. Apply 0.9 kV (tested in a Bio-Rad Micropulsar).

steps.title: Recovery and plating
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 500 uL of [BHI + v2 salts]. Outgrow the transformation resuspension at 37 °C (or 30 °C depending on the plasmid) with shaking or rotation. Plate the outgrowth onto LB plates with selection.
